item.content:encoded:
Aww, it's lonely. :'( Or maybe just bored with no necks to snap. I like the image of it dashing around the world on its tiny little legs, searching every building for…what?

Would you mind if I wrote a sequel to this?

item.content:encoded: Personally, I'd think SCP-173 would find a better place to be idle than its cramped cell, and remain there. I think that what it wants more than anything is to be left alone.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I think a spontaneous disappearance of anything that can look at 173 is a suitable description for what happened, as opposed to name-dropping a bunch of probable situations (which would have their own implications, and might result in different situations than the one proposed here).

The imagery where 173 roams endlessly in nice, and it ultimately feels like 173's own personal hell – forever roaming and with nothing to do.
